items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: So on the way back to Boston, Simon recommended I talk to Glenn Miller. So I did. And that’s where he hired me.

ctx.x: Sure, we can read between the lines on that.

Anyway, I was looking for a job, and we were at the hotel in Boston, I can’t remember, some plaza in Boston. So I came to New York on a day off. I talked to George Simon I guess. And I had called Benny Goodman and also Tommy Dorsey. No, I’m getting mixed up there at the end of the Miller thing, I’m sorry, that’s not right. But I did — Simon said, the Glen Island Casino was on the route between Boston and New York, and I was driving. So on the way back to Boston, Simon recommended I talk to Glenn Miller. So I did.…
